--src: Mathlib.Order.DirectedInverseSystem
theorem piSplitLE_lt {f : piLT X i × X i} {j} (hj : j < i) :
    piSplitLE f ⟨j, hj.le⟩ = f.1 ⟨j, hj⟩ := dif_neg hj.ne

--src: Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Option
/-- Permutations of `Option α` are equivalent to fixing an
`Option α` and permuting the remaining with a `Perm α`.
The fixed `Option α` is swapped with `none`. -/
@[simps]
def Equiv.Perm.decomposeOption {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] :
    Perm (Option α) ≃ Option α × Perm α where
  toFun σ := (σ none, removeNone σ)
  invFun i := swap none i.1 * i.2.optionCongr
  left_inv σ := by simp
  right_inv := fun ⟨x, σ⟩ => by
    have : removeNone (swap none x * σ.optionCongr) = σ :=
      Equiv.optionCongr_injective (by simp [← mul_assoc])
    simp [← Perm.eq_inv_iff_eq, this]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Diagonal
@[simp]
theorem one_apply_eq (i) : (1 : Matrix n n α) i i = 1 :=
  diagonal_apply_eq _ i

--src: Mathlib.Data.Matrix.PEquiv
@[simp]
theorem toMatrix_refl [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] [One α] :
    ((PEquiv.refl n).toMatrix : Matrix n n α) = 1 := by
  ext
  simp [toMatrix_apply, one_apply]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Hadamard
theorem one_hadamard : (1 : Matrix n n α) ⊙ M = diagonal fun i => M i i := by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h]

--src: Mathlib.Order.Compare
alias ⟨Compares.of_swap, Compares.swap⟩ := compares_swap
